skala_wrap_before_comma_in_base_clause #

A break in a base list lands before the comma. Not read by the C# formatter — but the behaviour is configurable, by `skala_wrap_before_comma`. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against the oracle at 2025.2.6 on constructs/wrapping/base-list.cs, one key at a time appended to the export: at true this key returns the file byte-identical, while skala_wrap_before_comma = true returns class C : Base / , IFirst / , ISecond { }. The base clause’s comma side is governed by the general comma key like every other comma, and this spelling is the C++ and VB formatters’. BreakPlan.PlanBaseList reads the general key now; reading this one is what made this row SPURIOUS.

Typetrue / false
Defaultfalse
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
